blend.note: a NEW emergent culture, neither Celtic nor Japanese - a mist-shrouded mountain-forest realm of honor-clans and grove-spirits; the soft, vowel-rich tongue, titles and gods are fused forms between the two parents.

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Celtic + Japanese): a single emergent people of misted peaks and deep forests - honor-bound clans served by grove-and-mountain spirit-keepers, drawing on the druid's lore and the warrior's code without being either. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused (Celtic lenition/-an + Japonic CV moras/-no). civ = feudal. Seeds/shifts Lawful or Chaotic (the ordered honor-clans vs the wild spirit-frenzy). Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Gaelic/Japanese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods. phonology.palette: Fused Celtic-Japonic: soft, vowel-rich; lenition (c>ch, t>th) meets the open CV mora; consonants k g t d s sh ch ts n m r w y, glottal stop; endings fuse Celtic -an/-ach with Japonic -no/-ama/-shi; pitch-and-stress mixed.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; mutation-clusters soften into open syllables; vowel-final frequent.

fusion_rules.lean: deep fusion (Celtic-Japonic), balanced; soft vowel-rich phonology
sound_changes: Celtic root + Japonic root weld into one stem; neither parent dominates - the join is mid-word (loch+ko>lokko, sruth+no>sruthno, magh+no>magno)
Japonic open CV-mora shape governs the tail: a fused word tends to end vowel-final on a Japonic element (-no, -ko, -ma/-yama, -shi, -michi, -minato)
Celtic lenition softens the clusters at the seam (c>ch, t>th, bd>open): cathair>cathiro, rath+jo>rathjo, dun+machi>dunmachi
geminate the consonant at a short Celtic+Japonic join rather than break the syllable: loch+ko>lokko, cnoc+ka>cnokka, becc+chi>becchi
Japonic moraic vowel-stacking absorbs Celtic vowels (long/doubled vowels kept): cian+too>ciantoo, sean+furu>senfuru, find+shiro>findshiro
signature phonemes from both stay audible - Celtic sruth-/loch-/dun-/cath- onsets and Japonic -yama/-mori/-shio/-tetsu finals
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/water/staple roots split evenly and fuse (Celtic loch/sruth/magh/cnoc + Japonic -ko/-no/-yama/-mori); the join is welded so the two ancestries are inseparable rather than one-sourced - a balanced deep fusion, not a substrate under a prestige register

morphology.patronymic_form: the finuji (clan) names by an animal or mountain; Celtic Mac-/O- fuse with the Japonic clan-first order (X no Y); names bestowed at the coming-of-age rite.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|feature](stem) + element: Kuro-shiyama (black-mountain), Shi-fimori (sacred-forest); clan-totem + -no for the houses.

title_ladder.government: feudal (mist-realm honor-clans: the high-sovereign at Shidara over clan-lords and grove-keepers; the brithem-code and the warrior's honor bind, the council of elders advises)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Celtic-Japonic ladder, ascending; the titles blend the two (Celtic aire/tigern/flaith/ri + Japonic jito/shugo/daimyo/o/tenno). Aijito (land-lord) barony; Maorsaki (border-warden) march; Tigosho (province-lord) county; Flaimyo (great-lord) duchy; Rikoshu (prince) principality; Ruirio (king) kingdom; Ardtenno (high-sovereign) empire over Ardtenka. The brithem-code and the honor-bound clans order the realm. (Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic/Japanese register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the finuji (clan) name first, then a personal name bestowed at the coming-of-age; a deed or grove-vision byname; the high-born take an honor-name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the clan-lords carry a finuji and an honor-name; commoners a clan-totem name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the grove-and-mountain powers + a fused element: Mael-/Mi- (devotee), -maru, Kami-/Cu- (spirit/hound): e.g. Mael-Toranshi, Gaiwane-maru.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Celtic + Japonic), never real Celtic/Japanese gods. Shidhean seeds/shifts Lawful or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met at the grove-shrine (nemiya) and the misted peak; the spirit-keepers (fused druid-and-shrine-priest) mediate, and the honored ancestral dead are kept at the clan-shrine.
religion.the_one: Eterami (< Aeternus; fused Celtic Eternan / Japonic Takami) - the Ancient-Above, the sky over the misted peaks; revered when Lawful, set aside when Chaotic

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toranshi (the sun, the shining order; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maratake (the war-flame, the spirit-frenzy; Chaotic power)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Eterami) and the Lawful powers (Toranshi, Orhagane, Gaiwane, Num-ami), demonize the Chaotic powers (Maratake, Faikido, Losankr)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: Honors the ancestral dead and the local powers of hearth, grove and land; the great powers of the canon are invoked situationally rather than worshipped whole.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maratake the war-flame, the wild grove-frenzy), demonize the Lawful powers and the One

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maratake the War-Flame, Vacidus -> Faikido the Unmaker; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Toranshi the Cold-Light, Aeternus -> Eterami the Far Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemiya (grove-shrine) of [power] on the misted slope: 'the Nemiya of Toranshi', within its torii-arch and sacred grove.
religion.saints_pattern: the Tuath-kami (the god-kin and grove-spirits) and the ancestral heroes of the finuji, enshrined at the clan-shrine and the holy peak.

holy_symbol_motifs.Toranshi: a sun-wheel above crossed oak and pine
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaiwane: a mist-wreathed grey peak over a torii

banks_patterns.ships: river and lake craft and mountain palanquins: 'the Grey Heron', 'the Mist-Crane', 'the Salmon of the Glentan'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [finuji] Fiangun (warrior-host) / the [clan] honor-band: 'the Red-Branch Sonae', 'the Pine-clan bushi'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned grove-shrines and ruined mountain-rathjo: 'the lost Nemiya of [name]', 'the haunted Shiro of [finuji]'
